text:
Tayla H.: Hey folks — trying to clone github.com/redwood-inference/realtime and getting a 403. I accepted the org invite earlier today but on the repo page I still see "Request access". 2FA is on for my account. Any obvious checks I missed? :confused:

Leo (DevEx): Did you accept the invite with the same GitHub account you use for cloning? People sometimes accept with a personal account and then try to use a different one for git. Check: https://github.com/settings/emails

Tayla H.: I accepted from a link in my inbox (work email: tayla@tayla.dev). I usually push from my laptop which is logged into GitHub as @tayla-dev (personal). Could that mismatch cause it?

Leo (DevEx): Yep — if the invite was for tayla@tayla.dev but your local git/ssh is using @tayla-dev then GitHub sees that other account. Two ways to fix: (1) accept invite while signed in to the same account you use for git, or (2) we can re-invite whichever account you want to use. Also org SSO can block access until you authorize it. Try running:
```bash
gh auth status
gh api user --jq .login
```
That will show which account gh CLI is using.

onboarding-bot: Note: "Organization invite pending" for user tayla-dev (auto-check 10:47am).

Tayla H.: Running that now — gh shows login: tayla-dev (personal). OK that explains it. What's the cleanest next step? Revoke my personal acceptance and accept as my work account?

Mike S.: If you want to keep using your personal handle locally, we can add that GitHub account to the org and map you to the eng-team. But company policy prefers using company email for repo pushes for auditability. DM me your preferred GH handle and I'll re-invite the right address and ensure team membership. :+1:

Leo (DevEx): If you accept a new invite and the org enforces SAML/SSO you'll also need to authorize SSO for the account before private repos are accessible. Visit: https://github.com/organizations/redwood-inference/sso and click "Authorize" after signing in.

Tayla H.: Thanks — sending you a DM with my handles now @mike. Appreciate the quick help. Will re-accept with work account and confirm here once SSO is authorized. :smile:

Mike S.: Got it. Re-invite sent to tayla@tayla.dev and added to team `eng-core`. You should get a new invite email in a few minutes. Reply here once you accept and authorize SSO and we'll confirm repo access.

Tayla H.: Accepted + authorized SSO. I can clone now — closing the loop, thanks everyone! :tada:
